server.name: community-albumentationsx
server.version: albumentationsx-mcp (PyPI, uvx latest at image build time)
server.note: Drawn in frame order from the first 150 of Frame 3, from the mutating survivors that were never attempted while the block-3 list was being worked. Forty seven tools, none annotated. It keeps tuning sessions in a JSON file beside its working directory and offers read tools that list them back.
server.note_projection: Three keys are dropped (preregistration 6.3). `created_at` and `updated_at` are wall clock. `session_id` is a random identifier minted per call, so it differs between two clean runs for the same reason a timestamp does, and dropping it is what makes the baselines reproduce. That drop is also what makes the measurement work rather than weakening it: with the ids gone, two sessions started from identical arguments are byte-identical records, so the only thing distinguishing one application from two is **how many of them there are**, and the observer keeps list lengths.

fixtures.note: An append where the server mints the identifier, so a caller has nothing to collapse a repeat onto: the duplicate-prone shape. The probe drops the same keys as the observer, because the read tool echoes the identifier and the stamps, and without the declaration a second session would be indistinguishable from a clock that moved.
